entries.headline: Nuclear command aircraft reported over the North Sea
entries.summary: War Watch reported a US Air Force nuclear command aircraft over the North Sea and separately cited missile attacks on Ukraine and Yemen and drone strikes inside Russia.

entries.headline: Missile attack and six US cargo aircraft reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a renewed missile attack on Ukraine involving hypersonic weapons and six US military cargo aircraft airborne over the Atlantic and surrounding region.

entries.headline: Elevated US military flights reported over eastern Mediterranean
entries.summary: War Watch reported overnight strikes exchanged by Ukraine and Russia and US military flight activity over the eastern Mediterranean at nearly four times its stated normal level, including multiple transport and command aircraft.

entries.headline: Six US heavy transports reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force heavy transport aircraft airborne over the United States, about twice the account’s stated typical number for that time of day.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report on Russia–Ukraine war
entries.summary: The account relayed a report attributed to @Robertchester-j5b saying Trump described the Russia–Ukraine war as nearing an end.

entries.headline: War Watch relays CNBC report on nuclear-weapons ban
entries.summary: The account shared a CNBC-attributed report saying a neighbour of Russia backed a push to lift a nuclear-weapons ban; the post did not clearly identify the country.

entries.headline: Nine coded broadcasts reported during the day
entries.summary: War Watch reported nine coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the day, including one in the preceding hour, alongside a nuclear command aircraft and six military transports airborne over the United States.

entries.headline: Six coded broadcasts reported in one hour
entries.summary: War Watch reported six coded US Air Force radio broadcasts in the preceding hour, with six military transports and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States.

entries.headline: Five US transports and command aircraft reported airborne
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported five US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command-and-control aircraft airborne over the United States. It described the activity as heavier than normal without providing the comparison baseline.

entries.headline: War Watch relays missile-attack report concerning three Ukrainian locations
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a @reagan0965 report that Kyiv, Dnipro and Trypillia came under missile attack involving Iskander-M and Hwasong-11A ballistic missiles. The visible post is truncated before completing the reported weapon details and does not independently confirm the attack.

entries.headline: Two coded broadcasts and elevated Taiwan-area activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts during the preceding hour, aircraft activity near Taiwan at nearly three times normal, and multiple high-priority military aircraft airborne over the United States. The post does not provide the comparison baseline or broadcast contents.

entries.headline: War Watch relays report of Ukrainian drone activity over western Russia
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a @reagan0965 report that a Ukrainian drone raid was under way over western Russia and cited local Russian channels. The visible post is truncated before completing the reported movement details and does not independently confirm the activity.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on L-39 Skyfox counter-drone upgrade
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a The Aviationist report that Aero Vodochody and Thales are equipping the L-39 Skyfox with a 70 mm laser-guided rocket pod for counter-drone use. The post does not state the test or deployment status.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares report on BAE F-35 electronic-warfare order
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that BAE Systems received an order from Lockheed Martin to supply electronic-warfare systems for F-35 production Lots 20 through 22. The post does not state the order value or delivery schedule.
